name: std::wcslen
intro:
Returns the length of a wide string, that is the number of non-null wide characters that precede the terminating null wide character.

The behavior is undefined if there is no null character in the wide character array pointed to by str.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated wide string to be examined

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The length of the null-terminated wide string str.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output: The length of L"Hello, world!" is 13

summary: Returns the length of a wide string, that is the number of non-null wide characters that precede the terminating null wide character.
